hooks.command: input=$(cat); f=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.kt|*.kts) jq -n --arg f "$f" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:("Kotlin/Gradle change detected in \($f). Consult the kmp-architect agent for architectural fit and the kotlin-code-quality-reviewer agent for code quality before treating this change as complete.")}}' ;; esac

input=$(cat); f=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */app/zepp/*.js) case "$f" in */proto.js) ;; *) jq -n --arg f "$f" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:("Zepp OS app change detected in \($f). Consult the zepp-architecture-specialist agent for design fit and the zepp-js-code-quality-reviewer agent for code quality before treating this change as complete.")}}' ;; esac ;; esac
